resourceTitle: Human Approval In Durable Agent Workflows
subtitle: What a workflow must remember while waiting for a person

sections.heading: The production issue
sections.body: Approval may arrive hours later, after a worker restart or deploy.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.body: The approval event should resume the workflow from the waiting step.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.body: Human-in-the-loop steps become fragile if they depend on one live process.

sections.heading: Workshop
sections.body: June 16 with Nicholas Lotz: approvals, retries, timeouts, traces, recovery, and deployment.
